title: Log: include skipped non-FIPS provider name in FIPS mode lookup rejection
description:
fd.c:737-740 (and matching sites in ioctl_key_import:1651, ioctl_do_kdf:1858, ioctl_key_generate:2024): when FIPS mode is active and a lookup returns NULL because the only matching provider is non-FIPS, the log says 'not found — FIPS mode active' but does not name which non-FIPS provider was skipped. Support engineers must manually cross-reference sysfs algorithms to diagnose.

Fix option A (simpler): add a second pass in crypto2dev_lookup_algo that runs after the FIPS-filtered pass, walks the same list with FIPS filtering disabled, and returns the first-matched provider name separately (out param). If the second pass finds something, include it in the rejection log: 'not found in FIPS mode (kcapi has this algo but is non-FIPS)'.

Fix option B (cheaper): add a pr_debug inside the FIPS-skip branch of crypto2dev_lookup_algo (registry.c) that names the provider being skipped. Visible only with dynamic debug but no API change needed.

Prefer option A for production observability.
